correctness.rationale: For m>=4, m−1 equal spokes and exceptional ratio t>0, the star Laplacian splits into ordinary-leaf contrasts and a 3x3 quotient. Its two nonzero quotient eigenvalues solve λ²−(m+2t)λ+(m+1)t=0. Exact rational adjugate factors for every off-diagonal orbit entry have strictly positive denominators for h>0. Within 1/2<=t<=m/(m−1), every numerator coefficient is positive; outside, a leading hub-to-leaf coefficient is negative for large h. F(z)=((z−3)²+3)/(z²+6z+12)>0 makes diagonal entries positive, and F(0)=1 preserves row sums. Independent SymPy/rational matrices for m=4,5 and interval endpoints corroborated sign conditions. This C result is independently also implied by an earlier fully proved arbitrary-weight theorem.
